problem_type: NSIS include paths must be valid for the compiler host and installer changes must compile before push
symptom: Windows run 40921209572 aborts at installer.nsh:39 before any installer scenario executes.
direct_cause: The generated manifest exists in the uploaded artifact, but PROJECT_DIR uses Windows backslashes and the include appends forward slashes. NSIS v304 get_file_name splits only on the host separator, so the basename includes the forward-slash suffix and cannot match the manifest.
class_root: Text-only manifest and template census tests never execute makensis. Cross-host path assembly can pass Mac and static tests while failing the Windows compiler.
affected_population: Windows packaging via win-installer.yml, win-gate.yml and desktop-rc.yml
Future NSIS include, generated manifest, or build.nsis changes
entry_points: electron-builder NSIS installer and BUILD_UNINSTALLER passes

external_sources.purpose: get_dir_name/get_file_name only split on host separator; Windows slash support is explicitly marked BUGBUG.
pp_include splits before enumerating directory and comparing file spec.
macOS tool dependencies downloaded on demand; checked installed 26.15.3 getMakeNsisPath and UninstallerReader implementation for exact behavior.

invariants: NSIS manifest include uses backslashes, converted by Unix makensis and native on Windows.
Production include, generated data macros and production nsis settings compile in both real electron-builder passes with warnings-as-errors before push.
A compiler error is a hard test failure; no platform or missing-tool skip.

door_reduction.why_not: door-map.mjs writeInstallerManifest renderNsh manifestPaths --roots=scripts,tests: afterPack must produce the manifest; manifestPaths and renderNsh are its shared path/render helpers and module exports. No parallel producer is added. The existing shared installer.nsh include is the sole consumer being repaired.

generality_proof: Both installer and uninstaller use the same corrected include; all Windows packaging entry points converge there. The new test invokes installed electron-builder build API with the real nsis config, real include and real generator. A Windows basename assertion covers the host-specific behavior Mac makensis alone cannot detect.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Use one cross-host resolvable manifest path for both compile passes.
Execute the production templates with generated manifest and actual configuration; fail on errors.
Select the real compile test on every installer input change.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Uses package.json build.nsis.include; same production template tested locally.
Shares package.json NSIS configuration and generated afterPack manifest.
Generated macros are included in both real compilation passes, including special-character fixture filenames.

recurrence.reason: Any later include, macro or NSIS configuration change can fail at compilation before installation tests run. The host separator issue affects every Windows package invocation.
same_class_scan: rg manifest/afterPack/productFilename/PRODUCT_FILENAME in generator, afterPack, package.json and full CI log; uploaded manifest verified present
Inspected win-installer.yml, desktop-rc.yml and installed NsisTarget.executeMakensis / computeScriptAndSignUninstaller

prevention.invariant: Changes to the installer include, generator, afterPack, build configuration or dependency lock select real NSIS compilation.
prevention.failure_mode: Default vitest and pre-push fail on path invariant or makensis error, including unavailable tools.
prevention.strategy: Register the compile test in SCAN_GUARDS and the default vitest lane instead of relying on a manual Windows push.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the mixed-separator manifest include; retain no alternate include or fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Compiler defect is bounded by native separators; 26.15.3 already ships mac/makensis and native uninstaller extraction. No new dependency or compiler install is needed.
dependency_lifecycle.target: Supported electron-builder / NSIS version retaining the production hooks
exit_criteria: On electron-builder or toolset upgrade, real two-pass compile test and Windows installer scenarios must pass; re-review template fingerprints.

migration: No persisted state changes; regenerate manifests normally in afterPack.
residual_risks: Mac compilation does not execute Windows installer, registry, NTFS lock or UAC behavior. A1-A13 and CX1-CX3 remain pending the coordinator push and Windows job.
The small compile fixture validates templates and syntax; it is not a runnable Nomi application. Full application packaging is verified separately.
